descriptions: Manage 45 lab accounts with $4.1 million in yearly renewals and 96% gross retention last year

Lead quarterly business reviews with lab directors and bring their requests back to the product team

Looked after 120 event agencies through the switch to a new ticketing platform, losing only four
Wrote the onboarding guide and video series that cut setup calls from three to one

Handled orders and delivery problems for 90 bars and restaurants across three cities
Kept the distributor price list current and caught billing errors before invoices went out
Set up delivery schedules with three distributors and handled out-of-stock calls
